name: skill
description: 统一 skill 工具（action 分派）。action=list 列出所有可用 skill（渐进式披露第一级：仅 name + description，token 消耗极小）；action=use 激活指定 skill 并返回完整指令模板（第二级；目录式 skill 附带附属资源清单；args 替换模板中的 {{placeholder}} 占位符）；action=create/update/delete 管理用户 skill（~/.moss/skills/<name>/SKILL.md，名称不可变）；action=search 按 keyword 搜索 SkillHub 技能市场；action=install 按 canonicalName（@owner/slug）从市场安装。skill 名称必须匹配 ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$。list/use/search 只读；create/update/delete/install 属于写操作，可能触发用户确认。
description_en: Unified skill tool (dispatched by action). action=list lists all available skills (progressive disclosure level 1: name + description only); action=use activates a skill and returns its full instruction template (level 2; directory-based skills include companion resources; args fill {{placeholder}} tokens); action=create/update/delete manage user skills (~/.moss/skills/<name>/SKILL.md; name is immutable); action=search queries the SkillHub market by keyword; action=install installs from the market by canonicalName (@owner/slug). Skill names must match ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$. list/use/search are read-only; create/update/delete/install are write operations and may require user confirmation.

skill.description_en: use: name of the skill to activate

args.description: use：替换到技能提示词占位符中的参数（如 {topic: "react hooks"} 对应 {{topic}}）。
args.description_en: use: arguments substituted into the skill prompt placeholders (e.g. {topic: "react hooks"} fills {{topic}}).

name.description: create/update/delete：目标 skill 名称（必须匹配 ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$；update 时不可改名）
name.description_en: create/update/delete: target skill name (must match ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$; immutable on update)

description.description: create 必填：skill 的简短描述（展示在 list 中）
description.description_en: Required for create: short skill description shown in list

icon.description: create/update：图标（Lucide kebab-case 名，或 .svg 文件名）
icon.description_en: create/update: icon (Lucide kebab-case name or .svg filename)

allowedTools.description: create/update：skill 激活时建议允许的工具列表（提示性约束）
allowedTools.description_en: create/update: suggested allowed tools when the skill is active (advisory)

canonicalName.description: install：技能市场安装标识，格式 @owner/slug
canonicalName.description_en: install: skill market install identifier, format @owner/slug
